$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the data-a area (packages/ui: list-row.tsx, swipe-row.tsx, filter-chip.tsx, section-header.tsx, log-row.tsx, diff-block.tsx, file-chip.tsx, table.tsx, highlight.tsx). Only the fixed sizes Figma names without a variable, and the swipe thresholds of contract §6.4, are knobs; every other padding, gap and height is on the 4px spacing scale (List Row 20 / 16 / 24, Section Header 32, Filter Chip 24, Log Row 40, File Chip 44).

leading-width.$description: The fixed leading column that holds the index (folio) or a leading part. Figma: 40, typed in.

progress-max-width.$description: The segmented progress bar fills the body up to this width. Figma: 360.

unread-size.$description: The unread mark of the message layout: a square in text-body, its bottom on the baseline. Figma: 6 × 6.

swipe-action.$description: SwipeAction (Figma 25:2042 "13. Swipe Action"): one action tile behind a swiped row.

width.$description: A tile's width. Figma draws 80 × 96; the height stretches to the row in code (96 fits no List Row height).

swipe-row.$description: SwipeRow thresholds (contract §6.4). Behaviour, not motion: the row reads them when a press starts and falls back to these same values without the stylesheet. The settle itself runs on --motion-spring-settle and stops under reduced motion.

reveal.$description: How far the pointer travels sideways (and more sideways than down) before the row moves. Under it a press stays a tap.

edge.$description: A right swipe that starts this close to the screen's left edge is left to the system's back gesture: it never reaches the leading action.

snap.$description: Released past this share of the actions' width, the row snaps open; under it, it closes.

full.$description: Released past this share of the row's width, a full swipe runs the outermost action, and only when that action is reversible (a confirm action opens its review instead). Otherwise the row opens and stops.
